messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Error message - Error in full_geno[mar, ] : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
That error usually means that full_geno is a function not an object. I'm not sure why that would happen in this context.

I'd be inclined to run the code by copy-paste a bit at a time, so when the error occurs you can look at what the objects are and maybe see what is going wrong.
karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Error message - Error in full_geno[mar, ] : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
Thank you!

full_geno is a function, defined as;

function(mat1, mat2)
  {
      cn1 <- colnames(mat1)
      cn2 <- colnames(mat2)
      m <- (cn2 %in% cn1)
      if(any(m)) {
          mat1[,cn2[m]] <- mat2[,cn2[m],drop=FALSE]
          if(any(!m)) {
              mat1 <- cbind(mat1, mat2[,cn2[!m],drop=FALSE])
          }
      }
      else {
          mat1 <- cbind(mat1, mat2)
      }

      mat1
  }

Which seems to happen after the geenseek data is read in. Do I need to edit this part of the script?

    if(is.null(full_geno)) {
        full_geno <- geno
    } else {
        # if any columns in both, use those from second set
        full_geno <- cbind_smother(full_geno, geno)

Or perhaps it's something to do with the format of my text files?
